challenges.finding: Publisher reports 16 patients not fed in the Mandima health zone (Ituri); no safe burial carried out in Tshopo for 5 alerts, because of failures, refusals or intervention constraints; and none in Bas-Uele because no safe-burial team is available, with weak reporting of community deaths. In Tshopo a meeting with partners and community leaders addressed resistance (4 resistances reported, 3 resolved during the day). The 4 Viadana control points in Bas-Uele that SR182 reported out of service because of a strike resumed activities after talks, the publisher reports. Restated from SR182 without change and not counted as new SR183 events: persistent insecurity and threats against response teams in Tshopo (Bafwasende, Kabondo and Mangobo; printed in SR173 and SR180 to SR182) and a strike by providers at a CTE in Ituri over unpaid wages (printed in SR171, SR173 to SR175, SR178, SR179, SR181 and SR182). No intervention effect is established.

Contact follow-up covers six reporting provinces. The Bas-Uele zero is withheld after the contact cohort moved between province labels in earlier editions. The lowest printed rate is Tshopo (77.6%). No zero follow-up is inferred for any province.
